title: Two Women in 1940s Tailored Skirt Suits on Porch, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of two adult women standing side by side on a porch step. Both are dressed in classic 1940s tailored two-piece skirt suits featuring structured padded shoulders, fitted jackets, and mid-calf skirts paired with heeled pumps. The background reveals a stucco building with an arched entrance, a wooden gate, and a laundry clothesline with clothespins.
